summary: Baileys WhatsApp library fork — weak static pattern, no traced installer harm
details: @alannxd/baileys@6.1.2 is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A a static rule fired on lib/Utils/generics.js citing keyword co-occurrence ('ping', 'GET', 'id'), but these tokens are consistent with the library's normal protocol handling (WhatsApp websocket presence/keepalive pings and HTTP GETs for media). No specific installer-side data read tied to a non-first-party destination was identified, no install/import-time fetch-and-execute path was found, no lifecycle scripts perform outbound actions, and no credential or filesystem-secret access was observed. As a third-party fork of a widely-used library, the maintainer's identity and any covert side-effects (e.g., auto-follow / install-counter behavior common to Baileys forks) warrant human review before broad use, but there is no traced evidence of a supply-chain attack on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
